[h1]Rescue Team 5[/h1]
Gelegenheitsspiel von 2015.

Tritt dem weltberühmten Rettungsteam bei und erlebe ein unvergessliches Abenteuer! Wieder einmal warten Menschen in Gefahr sehnsüchtig auf das Rettungsteam. Verwende deine besonderen Fähigkeiten, um Hindernisse zu beseitigen, zerstörte Infrastruktur neu zu errichten und besonders um Menschen in Gefahr zu retten. Während du durch Wüsten, schneebedeckte Berge und Dschungel voller Gefahren reist, rettest du Leben und baust mit klug gewählten Mausklicks Städte wieder auf. Verdiene über zwei Dutzend Auszeichnungen, die Zeugnis für dein Heldentum ablegen! Deine Reise wird am Fuße eines Vulkans enden, der jeden Augenblick auszubrechen droht. Wirst du es bis dahin schaffen und in einem explosiven Finale zum Retter in der Not werden? Tritt noch heute dem Rettungsteam bei und finde es heraus! (Herausgeber)

Soweit zum Hintergrund. Eigentlich müsste ich nichts weiter dazu schreiben, aber ich fasse mein Eindruck noch mal zusammen.
Ihr müsst halt Material sammeln um Gebäude wieder herzustellen und auf zu Rüsten. Mit den porduzierten Ressourcen rettet ihr dann Menschen und Tiere. Also alles wie gehabt.

Sehr gut gemachtes Leveldisign mit gut platzierten Ressourcen und Sperren. Tolle Animation und eine halbwegs gute Geschichte.
Wenn du was suchst um viel Spaß zu haben bist du hier richtig.
Aber: Es gibt Sperrlevel die dir eventuell das Spiel vermiesen.
Sie sind nur von hartnäckigen Spielern zu schaffen da du nur sehr wenig Zeit hast deine Aufträge zu erledigen. Bereite dich darauf vor LvL oft zu wiederholen.
Wenn du damit klar kommst das du etwa 4 Stunden ein gutes Game spielen kannst, dann hole es dir. Der Rest des Spiels ist aber so nicht zu erreichen. Insgesamt gesehen eher nicht empfohlen.
Ansonsten ist das Spiel sehr Kindgerecht.

[h1] Rescue Team 5 [/h1]
Casual game from 2015.

Join the world-famous rescue team and experience an unforgettable adventure! Once again, people in danger are waiting longingly for the rescue team. Use your special skills to remove obstacles, rebuild destroyed infrastructure and especially to save people in danger. As you travel through deserts, snow-capped mountains and jungles full of danger, you save lives and rebuild cities with cleverly chosen mouse clicks. Earn over two dozen awards that testify to your heroism! Your journey will end at the foot of a volcano that is about to erupt at any moment. Will you make it by then and become a savior in an explosive finale? Join the rescue team today and find out! (Editor)

So much for the background. Actually, I don't have to write anything else about it, but I'll summarize my impression again.
You just have to collect material to restore and upgrade buildings. With the produced resources you then save people and animals. So everything as usual.

Very well done level design with well placed resources and locks. Great animation and a reasonably good story.
If you are looking for something to have fun you are at the right place.
But: There are lock levels that may spoil the game for you.
They can only be created by persistent players as you have very little time to complete your tasks. Prepare to repeat LvL often.
If you can handle the fact that you can play a good game for about 4 hours, then get it. The rest of the game cannot be reached like this. Overall, not recommended.
In addition, the game is very suitable for children.

I've just requested a refund for this game because level 12 is so unreasonably difficult that from my perspective, it appears to be impassable.  To be completely fair, evidence found on the interwebs indicates that advancing past level 12 [i]has been done;[/i] but here's why -- unlike those determined souls -- i gave up trying and asked for my money back:

This level features a fire that threatens several citizens as it spreads; you can't extinguish it, you can only rush to helicopter the people to safety.  As implemented, the timing and/or strategy demands of this task seem unreasonably high; so much so that i was not only unable to succeed, i was also unable to enjoy trying.

No problem, right?  Just take a low star rating and move on, right?  Wrong: you can't proceed to level 13 if the fire reaches the people on level 12 (which, for me, it did every time).
  
In over a decade of playing time management games, this is the first time i have encountered such an impasse.  The way i see it, i [i]could[/i] spend hours failing this task over and over trying to get past it, but then what?  Will the remaining 2/3 of the game be increasingly MORE difficult and joyless?  Count me out.

On a side note, one player posted a discussion asking if level 12 was bugged, and the developer responded that one needed to "restore [the] Fire Department and also save a firefighter."  But... neither of those things is present on level 12.
